summary: Rewrote list_all for the current Tidewater contract: /v2 paths, cursor/limit pagination (filters on the first request only, stop at has_more=false, empty pages continue), and 429/503 retries (4 attempts, Retry-After seconds or HTTP date with 1s/2s fallbacks) via sleep/now; tests updated and passing. The docs disagree on the maximum limit (pagination page says 500, changelog says 200); I followed the pagination page (500).
